profile.descTranslate: Choose fixed-ratio copy trading and check (TradFI). We have been deeply involved in the financial trading market for many years, focusing on trend analysis, short-term swing trading, and systematic risk control trading. We do not gamble on one-sided trends, do not engage in aggressive trading, and do not frequently scalp trades. Our core trading philosophy is always stability, accuracy, and control.
